name: Kirkland Signature Artisan Country French Sourdough Bread
whyItWorks: Made with wild sourdough starter, water, flour, and salt. The slow 24-hour lactobacillus fermentation degrades fructans and wheat phytates, making authentic sourdough exceptionally gentle on sensitive IBD bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice and toast lightly. Discard overly hard or charred outer crust edges if dealing with active strictures.
